capabilities: Generate daily fortune reports from a four-layer Bazi analysis (natal chart, decade luck, year luck, day luck)
Display today's fortune in a home view and a right-sidebar widget with automatic midnight rollover
Insert today's or this week's fortune cards into notes at the cursor
Correct birth time using true solar time based on birthplace longitude
Compute favorable element to derive lucky color, direction and guidance
disambiguation: Not a weather forecast tool; 'weather' is a metaphor for the daily fortune the plugin computes from the user's Bazi chart.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installable via BRAT or manual download. README includes disclaimers that content is traditional-culture entertainment only, birth info stays local, and it depends on the lunar-javascript library. Simplified Chinese UI with English description.
problem: Obsidian has no way to show a personalized daily almanac-style fortune derived from the user's birth chart (Four Pillars), so journaling users must consult separate fortune apps.
summary: Daily fortune calendar that derives a Bazi-based 'life weather' report with do/avoid items, lucky color, auspicious hours and career/wealth/health/love trends.
